audits.action_consequence: If H1 holds, prioritize directions with high current shape_yy/shape_zz and positive rate/shape_yy; if rejected, downweight shape features in follow-up selection.
audits.statement: Elite terminal paths (path/0/37, path/0/7, path/2/12, path/3/25) end with shape_yy 6.3-7.6 and shape_zz 6.3-7.2, while the lowest observed terminal (path/1/21, 7.4404) ends with shape_yy ~5.9 and shape_zz ~6.28, supporting H1's shape-extent direction.

audits.action_consequence: If H2 holds, avoid directions with large positive rate/landmark_05_occupancy5 and rate/landmark_15_occupancy5; if rejected, treat landmark rates as uninformative.
audits.statement: Discovery contrast discovery/3 shows elite ancestors have lower landmark_05_occupancy5 and landmark_15_occupancy5 than ordinary ancestors, consistent with H2's local-occupancy direction.

audits.action_consequence: If H3 holds, prefer directions near the elite centroid basin with modest rate/global_centroid_y; if rejected, drop centroid features from the ranking rule.
audits.statement: Elite terminal paths converge to global_centroid_x near -0.01 and near-zero centroid_y/z, while discovery/0 shows elite-ordinary signed rate contrast with large negative rate/global_centroid_y, supporting H3's centroid-drift direction.

audits.action_consequence: If H4 holds, prefer compact-packing directions; if rejected, treat pair-kernel features as uninformative for follow-up.
audits.statement: Elite terminal paths retain pair_kernel_1.5 ~0.18-0.19 with pair_kernel_3.5 >= pair_kernel_5.0, while discovery/9 shows elite-ordinary signed rate contrast with negative rate/pair_kernel_3.5, supporting H4's compactness direction.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N006 (large negative rate/shape_yy, positive rate/shape_zz) yields higher measured pIC50 than N000, H1's static-shape direction is weakened in favor of signed-rate effects.
comparisons.remaining_confounding: Both have similar current shape_yy (6.43 vs 6.08) but N006 has extreme signed shape rates; current joint_head_pic50 differs by only 0.06, so measured outcome differences may reflect noise rather than the rate contrast.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N013 (large positive landmark rates) yields lower measured pIC50 than N000, H2's prediction is supported; if not, H2 is rejected.
comparisons.remaining_confounding: N013 has higher current landmark_05_occupancy5 (0.00052 vs 0.00042) and different centroid; the rate contrast is confounded with static occupancy level.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N002 (less compact packing) yields lower measured pIC50 than N000, H4 is supported; if N002 matches or exceeds N000, H4 is rejected.
comparisons.remaining_confounding: N002 also has higher current_Rg_A (1.108 vs 1.050) and different shape_yy (7.43 vs 6.43), so packing compactness is confounded with overall size and shape.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N006 (higher joint_head_pic50, extreme shape rates) yields higher measured pIC50 than N013 (extreme landmark rates), shape-rate effects dominate landmark-rate effects.
comparisons.remaining_confounding: Both have large-magnitude signed rates but in different feature families; current joint_head_pic50 differs by 0.65, so outcome differences may reflect the model score rather than the rate mechanism.

directions.rationale: Highest current joint_head_pic50 (8.956) with shape_yy 6.43 and shape_zz 5.77, near the elite terminal shape basin; tests H1 and H3 with a high-score, moderate-centroid state.

Second-highest joint_head_pic50 (9.0205) but with the largest negative rate/shape_yy (-10.36) and positive rate/shape_zz (13.07); discriminates H1 by testing whether large signed shape rates override static shape.

Large positive rate/landmark_05_occupancy5 (0.0167) and rate/landmark_15_occupancy5 (0.0272) with moderate joint_head_pic50 (8.376); directly tests H2's prediction that large positive landmark rates are worse.
Lowest joint_head_pic50 (7.902) with pair_kernel_1.5 0.172 and pair_kernel_7.0 0.223, the least compact packing; tests H4 and provides a low-score contrast to D1.

hypotheses.direction: Higher predicted pIC50 tracks larger shape_yy/shape_zz (more extended, anisotropic current shape) and positive rate/shape_yy; elite terminal paths end with shape_yy near 6.4-7.6 and shape_zz near 6.3-7.2, while the lowest observed terminal (path/1/21, 7.4404) ends with shape_yy ~5.9 and shape_zz ~6.28.
hypotheses.reject_if: If the four selected directions with the largest current shape_yy/shape_zz do not yield higher measured final pIC50 than the two with the smallest, or if measured pIC50 is flat across the shape_yy range 5.8-7.4, this hypothesis is rejected.

hypotheses.direction: Higher predicted pIC50 tracks moderate landmark_00_occupancy5 (~0.66-0.73) with low landmark_05/15 occupancy5 (<=~0.001) and near-zero or negative rate/landmark_05_occupancy5; candidates with large positive rate/landmark_05_occupancy5 and rate/landmark_15_occupancy5 (e.g. N013, N016) are predicted to be worse.
hypotheses.reject_if: If directions with large positive rate/landmark_05_occupancy5 and rate/landmark_15_occupancy5 (N013, N016) match or exceed measured pIC50 of directions with near-zero rates (N000, N001), this hypothesis is rejected.

hypotheses.direction: Elite terminal paths converge to small negative global_centroid_x (~-0.01) and near-zero centroid_y/z, with modest signed rates; candidates whose current centroid is far from that basin (|centroid_x|>0.08) or whose rate/global_centroid_y is large in magnitude (|rate|>2) are predicted to be worse.
hypotheses.reject_if: If measured pIC50 is uncorrelated with distance of current centroid from the elite terminal basin, or if large |rate/global_centroid_y| directions (N009, N013, N016) are not worse than small-rate directions, this hypothesis is rejected.

hypotheses.direction: Higher predicted pIC50 tracks pair_kernel_1.5 ~0.18-0.19 with pair_kernel_3.5 >= pair_kernel_5.0 (compact, locally dense packing); candidates with pair_kernel_1.5 <0.18 and pair_kernel_7.0 >0.21 (N002, N009, N014) are predicted to be worse.
hypotheses.reject_if: If directions with pair_kernel_1.5 <0.18 and pair_kernel_7.0 >0.21 (N002, N009, N014) match or exceed measured pIC50 of directions with pair_kernel_1.5 ~0.185-0.19, this hypothesis is rejected.
